# LCD subpixels

A macro view of an LCD: every pixel is three red, green and blue stripes with dark gaps, and slow pixels leave ghosts behind moving things.

<EffectDemo effect="lcd" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { lcd } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/lcd';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(lcd({ preset: 'macro' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.cellSize = 6`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                         | Default | Range      | Description                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cellSize`              | number                       | `6`     | 3 – 24 px  | Size of one LCD pixel on screen.                               |
| `layout` _(structural)_ | 'rgb' \| 'bgr' \| 'diagonal' | `'rgb'` |            | Subpixel order: RGB stripes, BGR stripes, or shifted each row. |
| `gap`                   | number                       | `0.2`   | 0.01 – 0.5 | Width of the dark gaps between subpixels.                      |
| `persistence`           | number                       | `0.4`   | 0 – 0.95   | How slowly pixels respond: higher values leave longer ghosts.  |
| `brightness`            | number                       | `1.2`   | 0.5 – 2    | Backlight brightness.                                          |
| `amount`                | number                       | `1`     | 0 – 1      | Mix between the original and the LCD view.                     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                            |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `macro`    | `cellSize: 12`, `gap: 0.3`          |
| `handheld` | `cellSize: 4`, `persistence: 0.7`   |
| `phone`    | `layout: 'diagonal'`, `cellSize: 5` |
| `sharp`    | `persistence: 0`, `gap: 0.1`        |

Apply one with `lcd({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 12.8 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/lcd`, including the shared effect runtime.
